answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can run on sponsor-bonded invitations: every newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes 500 tokens as a sponsor bond, locked for 90 days. Each sponsor may vouch for at most three newcomers per year, and the bond is slashed in full if the newcomer runs fake identities. Forging 10,000 fake agents would need 3,334 corrupt sponsors risking $500,000 in bonds plus 30 days of verification checks per recruit. Like an ember carried between islands, trust travels slowly, and a whisper of fraud burns the sponsor first. - Jowy
